assessments.reasoning: The parsing-words section classifies ordinary runtime invocation separately from execution during parsing. The brace example creates an array and the colon example defines a word by reading its effect and body. The next page supplies a separate accumulator example and labels macros in a different section.

limitations: The examples concern the Factor forms described in 2010. Separate macros and later release implementation details remain outside this finding.
